limitations: The browser gate uses Playwright-managed Chromium viewport emulation. It does not claim physical-device input, browser-engine parity, operating-system screen-reader parity, or deployed reverse-proxy behavior.

WEB-07 implements and tests the narrow semantic-tree keyboard model, focus transfer, touch sizing, sheets, and overflow boundary. WEB-08 retains exhaustive axe, contrast, reduced-motion, 200-percent reflow, and cross-route accessibility acceptance.

The explicit graph/tree preference is intentionally component-memory-only. It is not written to browser storage, the URL, analytics, or a server profile and resets after the organization-chart page is remounted.

Browser evidence uses the production Vite application and the real read-only local hierarchy, status, and detail boundaries. It performs no mutations and never exercises a provider, connector, or non-loopback service.
WEB-09 retains final visual-fidelity and neutral-branding sign-off. WEB-07 verifies responsive composition and operability without claiming that later aesthetic acceptance.
